task: Fix the BaseNode crash when a full context reset (clear_context_store) is combined with an explicit output key so the context holds only the output key, and add an offline pytest harness that runs all 64 built-in workflow templates through WorkflowExecutor.validate_workflow and fails on any error (codemie backend only).

key_reasoning.reason: BaseNode (_prepare_resolved_context_store / _add_output_key / finalize_and_update_state) plus the add_or_replace_context_store reducer in workflows/models.py, and a test-only harness over WorkflowExecutor.validate_workflow. Two closely coupled runtime components and a test module, all in the workflow package.

Both ACs are concrete, but how 'only the output key survives' is expressed through the reducer (None vs keep-new-only flag), and its interaction with append_to_context, store_in_context and reset_keys_in_context_store, is unsettled. Whether the compile step is in scope for the harness, and how the autonomous (no states) and placeholder templates are treated, is also open.

Closest pattern is the keep_current keep-new-only sentinel flow and tests/codemie/workflows/test_placeholder_no_rejection.py for offline validation. Neither covers the exact combination. Existing TC_FI_006/TC_FI_010 pin the no-output-key full-reset contract. The harness could surface currently failing templates (not run). No security, auth or performance sensitivity.

About 1-2 source files (base_node.py, possibly models.py) and 1-2 existing test files extended, plus 1-2 new test modules (reset+output_key tests, template corpus harness). Roughly 5-6 files across src/ and tests/. No migration, schema or template edits expected, unless the harness finds failing templates.
